# P3 — дополнительный low-risk mechanisms / semantic and coverage boundaries

Навигация: [P0](P0.md) · [P1](P1.md) · [P2](P2.md) · [P3](P3.md) · [P4](P4.md) · [primary coverage](#supplemental-primary-coverage) · [plans](#supplemental-plan-index).

## Правило среза и ограничения

Дата дополнительной консолидации: 2026-10-09; входной independent cycle-2 датирован 2026-10-08.

**Это дополнительный risk/debt срез, НЕ исходный plan priority и НЕ новая независимая очередь.** Пользователь отдельно назначил P3 для scoped low и P4 для nit/style. Во всех 189 полных входных reports исходные plan priorities — P0/P1/P2; источник не объявляет исходных P3/P4. Lowercase percentile p99/p99.9 не превращён в P-уровень. Исходные P0.md/P1.md/P2.md сохранены без изменений: их 3176 primary decisions, 447 plans (91/194/162) и 34 source-verdict пересмотра не переразносятся.

Основа — последняя принятая статическая консолидация [P0](P0.md#методика-и-проверенный-срез), [P1](P1.md#методика-и-проверенный-срез), [P2](P2.md#методика-и-проверенный-срез), а не исходные cycle-2 verdicts как готовое доказательство. Все 189 входных Markdown и их history вновь доступны целиком в памяти: 84777 строк / 7740601 Unicode characters. Текущие IDs/risk взяты только из authoritative prefixes; collapsed history не создаёт дополнительных строк. Пояснения/callers/oracles/registration и exact dependency qualifications переиспользованы из accepted canon; для новых facets отдельно названа граница. 801 обнаруженных cited source/contract/config текстов прочитаны без исполнения и fingerprinted при этом продолжении; это не заявление о повторном exhaustive source audit.

Frozen e3765c93 — происхождение входных reports, не сегодняшний working-tree guarantee. Current file:line здесь относится к прочитанному изменённому дереву; внешние пользовательские source/toolchain/dependency правки не принадлежат xxs. Pins/installed-target/runtime ограничения остаются в [exact source discipline](P0.md#exact-dependencycontract-дисциплина). Указанные Wasmtime 48.0.5 / rustls 0.23.45 / declared Rust 1.95.0 — прочитанные версии, не запущенные инструменты. Последовательные normalized UTF-8/LF fingerprints и readback не создают атомарного/deployed snapshot; непросмотренные installed/deployment facets не сертифицируются.

**Read-only:** в этом продолжении записываются только P3.md и P4.md. Ни compiler/cargo/build/lint/fmt/tests/benchmarks, ни проект/воспроизведения, ни новые агенты не запускались; auxiliary/temp файлов и git mutation нет. Наличие теста, registry/manifest и Cargo.lock означает соответствующий source fact/provenance, не выполненную проверку или callable oracle seam. Стоимости структурные, без количественных измерений. Нет generic quota/validation recipes, придуманных consumer seams или новых future oracles.

Verdict source row в ledger всегда принадлежит accepted P0–P2. Supplemental facet verdict описывает именно выбранный остаток: fixed — конкретный source-fixed mechanism, refuted — named counter-evidence, N/A — policy/optional redesign/calibration, unverified — missing premise, не safe. Closed/higher-risk redirects исключены из active table. Mixed bundle не понижен целиком: original risk и P allocation видны рядом с link на существующий canon. Составной row может покрывать несколько leaves; его primary count всё равно один.

## Арифметика и пересечение с P0–P2

Полный authoritative risk census: low **882**, nit **445**, medium **555**, high **159**, — **688** = **2729 Claim+Observation** (2635+94); ещё 447 Plan в этот risk знаменатель не входят. Raw low/nit — duplicate-inclusive строки, не bugs. После qualification supplemental primary union = **1455**: 882 raw-low + 445 raw-nit + 2 accepted-low SDK-doc rows с исходной medium меткой + 126 отдельных style/calibration rows с исходной — меткой. Каждый selected source ID primary ровно в одном из P3/P4. Все 28 raw lower-risk observations присутствуют: 27 имеют primary P3 и 1 — primary P4.

**Totals между original и supplemental views НЕ суммируются.** Эти source IDs уже входят в 3176 решений P0–P2; новые файлы показывают другой срез тех же данных. Канонические детали, plans и cross-references могут повторяться. Even P3/P4 facet counts не являются количеством независимых runtime bugs: сюда входят scope facets, maintenance bundles, закрытые calibration и redirects.

Этот файл: primary **923** = Claim 896 + Observation 27; no primary Plan rows. Selected facets/decision cards **355** = active/partial/unverified 348 + fixed/refuted/N/A 3 + higher-risk-only redirects 4. Related original plan references **239**; они не прибавляют bugs.

Из 445 raw-nit **39** имеют primary P3: 11 относятся к уже accepted-low boundaries, ещё 28 имеют конкретную conditional semantic/error/security/consumer boundary вместо чистого style. Оставшиеся **406** raw-nit primary в P4; четыре из них redirect к medium NEON/WS механизму, не active nits. Две SDK get-doc rows добавлены в P3 по уже accepted scoped-low doc canon, не вопреки его medium raw allegation. P4 дополнительно показывает 126 pure-style/structural calibrations: 53 текущие thematic style — rows, 54 same-guarantee linked counterparts и 19 явно проверенных summary/non-theme counterparts. Pure optional file splitting, visibility/root-export uniformity и wording choice не стали mandatory defect.

TASK 17 — отдельная qualification: accepted partial campaign status сохранён, tags source-fixed, но непоставленные legacy shims — N/A в этом дополнительном debt срезе при явно отсутствующем alpha upgrade promise. TASK 30 — structural source fixes не реактивированы; оставлена отдельная partial isolated-delivery/ignore-revs attribution facet. Runtime/error-return portions старых nit bundles cross-reference P3/существующие canonical guarantees, а не исчезают под стилевым названием.

<a id="l3-rv-bench-utils-92355828"></a>

### L3-RV-BENCH-UTILS-92355828 — next_range can reach hi even when next_f32 is strictly inside its promised interval

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-bench-utils`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-BENCH-UTILS-92355828](P2.md#rv-bench-utils-92355828) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Choose valid finite bounds lo=1, hi=1+2^-23 and a reachable uniform value 0.75. The interpolation computes 1+3*2^-25, which rounds to hi. The LCG's invertible step permits a predecessor seed whose successor high word is 0xC0000000, giving exactly 0.75 under both present and proposed 24-bit mappings. This is independent of the assigned next_f32=1 endpoint mechanism. Current fixture callers use different bounds, so impact is a public helper contract and incomplete fix recipe, not demonstrated production failure.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs:67](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs:75](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs:78](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs:81](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs); [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs:214](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs:67](../../../../crates/shamir-bench-utils/src/vector_data.rs): <code>self.state = self.state.wrapping_mul(LCG_MULT).wrapping_add(LCG_INC); / self.state / }</code>.

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** A complete five-byte Map32 header can pass RecordView::new without an entry body. The public index method requests Fx-map capacity from the declared count before checking the first malformed entry; malformed input therefore reaches reservation rather than a reservation-error Result.

Count-proportional requested capacity is structural, not a measured allocation or observed termination.

<a id="l3-rv-client-node-050ef626"></a>

### L3-RV-CLIENT-NODE-050EF626 — `create_scram_user` wrapper msgpack-decodes 16 raw user_id bytes and discards the result

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-client-node`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-CLIENT-NODE-050EF626](P2.md#rv-client-node-050ef626) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Besides avoidable decoding, there is a valid false-positive shape. The 16 bytes 82 a4 6b 69 6e 64 a5 65 72 72 6f 72 a1 78 a1 79 encode {kind:error,x:y}; inspected codec 3.1.3 accepts that map, and the wrapper throws ShamirDbError with undefined code/message. The directory's unrestricted random-byte generator permits this ID; its masked first-eight-byte principal is nonzero, and it is accepted when unused. This is a rare valid-ID edge case, not a measured incidence or remote privilege escalation.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-client-node/wrapper.js:82](../../../../crates/shamir-client-node/wrapper.js); [crates/shamir-client-node/wrapper.js:123](../../../../crates/shamir-client-node/wrapper.js); [crates/shamir-client-node/src/lib.rs:268](../../../../crates/shamir-client-node/src/lib.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/admin.rs:223](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/db_handler/admin.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/user_directory.rs:513](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/user_directory.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/user_directory.rs:526](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/user_directory.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/access.rs:33](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/access.rs).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-client-node/wrapper.js:82](../../../../crates/shamir-client-node/wrapper.js): <code>const decoded = decode(new Uint8Array(buf)); / if (decoded &amp;&amp; decoded.kind === 'error') { / throw new ShamirDbError(decoded.code, decoded.message);</code>.

**Source rows / исходная risk-метка:** [shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md · Claim 1.5](shamir-client-node/SUMMARY.md#review-1-5) (`low`, accepted `confirmed-open`).

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-client-node`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-CLIENT-NODE-C35E4678](P2.md#rv-client-node-c35e4678) (allocation P2, scoped risk `nit`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

<a id="l3-rv-collections-a5293f80"></a>

### L3-RV-COLLECTIONS-A5293F80 — Infallible capacity constructors can only abort the process; no fallible counterpart exists

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-collections`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-COLLECTIONS-A5293F80](P1.md#rv-collections-a5293f80) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The corrected current claim remains: helpers are infallible and undocumented. Its literal only-abort title is false because hashbrown 0.17.1 panics on capacity overflow. A raw Map32 header reaches new_map_wc before entries are read, contradicting the historical trusted-capacity assurance. Missing try helpers alone is an API choice; accepting unchecked declared counts is the caller hazard. Source: https://docs.rs/crate/hashbrown/0.17.1/source/src/raw.rs.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Infallible undocumented allocation remains, but only-abort is false for overflow.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs:29](../../../../crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs); [Cargo.toml:88](../../../../Cargo.toml); [crates/shamir-types/src/codecs/interned/messagepack.rs:251](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/codecs/interned/messagepack.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/codecs/interned/messagepack.rs:318](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/codecs/interned/messagepack.rs); [crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs:53](../../../../crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs); [Cargo.lock:1600](../../../../Cargo.lock).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs:29](../../../../crates/shamir-collections/src/lib.rs): <code>pub fn new_map_wc&lt;K: Eq + Hash, V&gt;(capacity: usize) -&gt; TMap&lt;K, V&gt; { / IndexMap::with_capacity_and_hasher(capacity, THasher::default()) / }</code>.

<a id="l3-rv-connect-b11f48ca"></a>

### L3-RV-CONNECT-B11F48CA — ResumeConfig public key mutation leaves permanent cipher caches bound to old keys

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-connect`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-CONNECT-B11F48CA](P1.md#rv-connect-b11f48ca) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** After ciphers() initializes its OnceLocks, a caller with mutable ResumeConfig can change ticket_key or ticket_key_previous without invalidating either cache. A supposedly revoked old key continues decrypting, while issuance via the new raw key disagrees with cached resume encryption/decryption. Existing rotation tests mutate before first cache use and miss this lifecycle. Shipped configuration is constructed into an immutable shared Arc; no live key mutation was found. The discriminating oracle must warm the caches before changing/removing a key.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs:130](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs:139](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs:164](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/tests/integration_resume.rs:460](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/tests/integration_resume.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/tests/integration_resume.rs:508](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/tests/integration_resume.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_launcher.rs:550](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/server/server_launcher.rs).

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-connect`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-CONNECT-F8A5E821](P1.md#rv-connect-f8a5e821) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Two rotations can publish different keys with the same version. A finalizer paused after loading an expired overlap can overwrite a newly rotated state. Mirror publication is separate. No live server rotate caller was found; sequential rotation tests cannot discriminate these schedules.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Snapshot-based stores and a separate version mirror admit lost updates; no live server rotate caller was found. Lost snapshot updates remain, but mirror-matching tickets can still resume; universal rejection is not the mechanism.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs:169](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs:194](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs:100](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs:152](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs:173](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/rotation.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/scheduler.rs:233](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/scheduler.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/tests/integration_rotation.rs:40](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/tests/integration_rotation.rs); [crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs:290](../../../../crates/shamir-connect/src/server/resume.rs).

### L3-RV-DB-830B18FC — Repeated curl resolve lines discard earlier validated addresses

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-db`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-DB-830B18FC](P2.md#rv-db-830b18fc) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

<a id="l3-rv-engine-95ecc2fe"></a>

### L3-RV-ENGINE-95ECC2FE — Precomputed one_of rejects allowed NaN values accepted by the original equality contract

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-engine`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-ENGINE-95ECC2FE](P2.md#rv-engine-95ecc2fe) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** With one_of containing QueryValue::F64(NaN) and an F64 NaN field, the original/fallback Vec::contains accepts because Value::PartialEq explicitly makes NaNs equal. OneOfSet::contains_scalar instead uses primitive rf == f, which is false. SchemaValidator always supplies the precomputed set; ordinary F64 validation does not prohibit NaN. The registered additions exercise string lists and empty constraints, not this case. Compare SchemaValidator and the legacy check_for_test path using the same NaN-bearing rule/record. MessagePack can represent the value; no JSON NaN support or timing claim is needed.

<a id="l3-rv-engine-d0cf9dfa-semantic-facet"></a>

### L3-RV-ENGINE-D0CF9DFA-SEMANTIC-FACET — FkReverseCache::get_or_build_by_parent — unbounded CAS-loss retry while holding build_lock

**Дополнительный verdict:** `partially-fixed`. **Модули:** `shamir-engine`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-ENGINE-D0CF9DFA](P2.md#rv-engine-d0cf9dfa) (allocation P2, scoped risk `nit`, verdict `partially-fixed`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** CAS losses yield but rebuild retries remain unlimited under build_lock. A privileged invalidation before each publish can starve waiters; no ordinary workload incidence is established.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Conditional wait progress under repeated privileged invalidation is a liveness obligation. Retry yields, but sustained privileged invalidation can indefinitely retain build_lock. <a id="l3-rv-funclib-0418c20f"></a>

### L3-RV-FUNCLIB-0418C20F — encode's advertised lossless safe-variant roundtrip excludes neither non-finite F64 nor recognized typed map-key prefixes

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-funclib`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-FUNCLIB-0418C20F](P1.md#rv-funclib-0418c20f) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** encode.rs promises lossless Null/Bool/Int/F64/Str/List/Map roundtrips. Published serde_json 1.0.149 src/ser.rs serializes F64 NaN/infinity as null. Independently, a native/query-produced map key i:x is serialized literally but QueryValue's visitor strips the recognized prefix on decode; incompatible values can make parsing fail. The existing finite-F64/plain-key fixture catches neither. Narrow/document the accepted domain or define a separate faithful conversion contract; do not silently change established prefix semantics. Grouping covers the shared recognized-key-prefix component only. JSON non-finite-number projection to Null is an additional distinct facet of this observation.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-funclib/src/encode.rs:27](../../../../crates/shamir-funclib/src/encode.rs); [crates/shamir-funclib/src/encode.rs:147](../../../../crates/shamir-funclib/src/encode.rs); [crates/shamir-funclib/src/encode.rs:160](../../../../crates/shamir-funclib/src/encode.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/types/value.rs:214](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/types/value.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/types/value.rs:268](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/types/value.rs); [crates/shamir-funclib/src/tests/encode_tests.rs:202](../../../../crates/shamir-funclib/src/tests/encode_tests.rs); [Cargo.lock:3244](../../../../Cargo.lock).

<a id="l3-rv-funclib-775adabc"></a>

### L3-RV-FUNCLIB-775ADABC — Generic canonical APIs do not exclude an interned _prev_hash field despite their unconditional reserved-field documentation

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-funclib`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-FUNCLIB-775ADABC](P1.md#rv-funclib-775adabc) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The public generic canonical_bytes/hash documentation says top-level _prev_hash is excluded and discusses InnerValue as supported. Detection compares serialized keys only to the MessagePack string _prev_hash. Numeric interned keys cannot match that string encoding, so changing the interned reserved field changes canonical bytes even within one interner. QueryValue scalar and the located test-local CAS validator use string keys and avoid this facet. **Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Map entries feed the hash in IndexMap order. Equal maps built in opposite insertion order can miss the same functional lookup. Canonical ordering is safer than blindly copying XOR aggregation, which has its own collision properties; migrate persisted hashes.

<a id="l3-rv-numa-cf3796d2"></a>

### L3-RV-NUMA-CF3796D2 — `parse_cpulist` expands unbounded ranges -- malformed input can panic/abort the process

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-numa`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-NUMA-CF3796D2](P1.md#rv-numa-cf3796d2) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Valid ascending ranges and repeated tokens expand without budgets. The mechanism is present, but malformed-token skipping does not promise bounded handling of every valid range. Current trusted sysfs callers warrant lower severity than an established service-input DoS.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Neither individual range spans nor cumulative intermediate expansion are bounded. Materialization is unbounded by policy, but current inputs are trusted and large ranges are syntactically valid, not the malformed tokens promised to be skipped. Materialization precedes sort/dedup, with neither span nor cumulative expansion limits. Hostile strings matter only if an embedding caller accepts them; current callers read kernel sysfs. Resource consumption is structural, while exact abort timing is unmeasured.

### L3-RV-QUERY-BUILDER-MACROS-EEE42189 — Quadratic token re-interpolation when accumulating builder chains in loops

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-query-builder-macros`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-QUERY-BUILDER-MACROS-EEE42189](P1.md#rv-query-builder-macros-eee42189) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** quote 1.0.45 ToTokens clones the prefix; proc-macro2 1.0.106 unwraps/flushed cloned DeferredTokenStreams. Tagged Rust 1.94.0 concatenation calls push_tree/push_stream; Arc::make_mut and iter().cloned()/extend copy growing top-level prefixes. Hence fixed-size method fragments incur quadratic aggregate prefix work. Nested groups are shared, not universally deep-copied. [Exact backend](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/1.94.0/compiler/rustc_ast/src/tokenstream.rs#L612).

<a id="l3-rv-query-types-5f9d5468"></a>

### L3-RV-QUERY-TYPES-5F9D5468 — QueryRecord PartialEq violates transitivity through the opaque-row Null sentinel

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-QUERY-TYPES-5F9D5468](P2.md#rv-query-types-5f9d5468) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Let A=IdBytes([0x81,0x01,0x01]), B=Direct(Null), C=IdBytes([0x81,0x01,0x02]). Mixed comparisons use as_value, giving A==B and B==C; the two-IdBytes fast path compares bytes, giving A!=C. These can be valid distinct id-keyed maps. The impl is compiled in production despite its for-tests comment, and QueryResult derives it. A three-value law test would discriminate the defect. It violates the [Rust 1.94.0 PartialEq contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/rust/1.94.0/library/core/src/cmp.rs); no deployed dedup/control-flow use was established.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs:185](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs); [crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs:289](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs); [crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_result.rs:121](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_result.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/types/value.rs:287](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/types/value.rs); [rust-toolchain.toml:15](../../../../rust-toolchain.toml).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs:185](../../../../crates/shamir-query-types/src/read/query_record.rs): <code>/// * `IdBytes(_)` — `Cow::Owned(QueryValue::Null)`: the bytes are an opaque / ///   id-keyed msgpack blob; field-level access is not meaningful until the / ///   client de-interns the keys.  Callers that need field access must</code>.

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-QUERY-TYPES-A3D93402](P1.md#rv-query-types-a3d93402) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-QUERY-TYPES-C000A440](P2.md#rv-query-types-c000a440) (allocation P2, scoped risk `nit`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

The old encoder-depth witness is refuted; allocation failure is conditional and unmeasured. ### L3-RV-QUERY-TYPES-FF6DD2A7 — `FilterValue` — 13-variant `#[serde(untagged)]` enum: content buffering + ~6 failed map-shaped trials per marker value

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-query-types`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-QUERY-TYPES-FF6DD2A7](P1.md#rv-query-types-ff6dd2a7) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

<a id="l3-rv-sdk-macros-0a76d271"></a>

### L3-RV-SDK-MACROS-0A76D271 — `unsafe` slice construction from unverified `(ptr, len)`; negative `len` is immediate UB

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-sdk-macros`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-SDK-MACROS-0A76D271](P1.md#rv-sdk-macros-0a76d271) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** All four safe public exports construct slices from caller-supplied integers. Negative len violates slice extent requirements; a safe Rust call with ptr=0,len=0 also violates non-null requirements. Ordinary WASM host calls use checked lengths and allocated ranges. A sign guard alone does not prove allocation, provenance, initialization or aliasing, nor make the safe export sound.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Negative-length rejection is absent; valid zero-length allocation is not a defect. Initialized allocation followed by overwrite is source-proven, but separate memset cost is not.

<a id="l3-rv-sdk-macros-966aa3ad"></a>

### L3-RV-SDK-MACROS-966AA3AD — Raw function identifiers panic during helper-name construction

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-sdk-macros`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-SDK-MACROS-966AA3AD](P1.md#rv-sdk-macros-966aa3ad) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** A valid annotated async function named r#type reaches format("__shamir_impl_{}", fn_name), producing __shamir_impl_r#type, which is not an identifier. proc-macro2 1.0.106 preserves the raw prefix in Display and rejects invalid characters in Ident::new; published src/fallback.rs:805/850/910 and compiler delegation in src/wrapper.rs:674 confirm the mechanism: https://docs.rs/crate/proc-macro2/1.0.106/source/src/fallback.rs. The compiler-facing constructor contract also requires a valid identifier: https://doc.rust-lang.org/proc_macro/struct.Ident.html. All four macros use this construction. A compile-pass raw-name fixture would discriminate a repair; no reproduction was executed.

<a id="l3-rv-storage-1a5a9374"></a>

### L3-RV-STORAGE-1A5A9374 — NIT: cross-path write ordering inside FjallStore rests only on fjall's internal journal mutex arrival order

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-storage`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-STORAGE-1A5A9374](P2.md#rv-storage-1a5a9374) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Exact fjall 3.1.6 src/keyspace/mod.rs and src/batch/mod.rs acquire the journal writer, confirming serialization but not submission intent across independent routes/handles. Overlapping reordering is not inherently a correctness violation.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Drop joins workers, so ordering overstatement and conditional churn are supported, not a leak. Published fjall 3.1.6 confirms journal locking, but it orders arrival, not intent across worker and blocking-pool routes. Exact fjall source confirms deleted point-write handles return KeyspaceDeleted rather than freely remaining writable. Each store_get constructs a new OnceLock; only insert/transact use it. Point writes are not universally ordered with transactions, and lazy worker teardown is explicitly joined rather than leaked.

### L3-RV-TRANSPORT-IPC-FA481516 — chmod-after-bind race window (documented, spec-prescribed — report as accepted risk with a structural option)

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Publication precedes chmod exactly as the normative sequence specifies. On Linux, an outsider additionally needs directory traversal and initial socket write permission; umask 022 does not provide outsider write permission. <a id="l3-rv-transport-tcp-0a23323d"></a>

### L3-RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-0A23323D — TLS convenience builders retain conditional provider/suite panic paths; stock auto-install is counter-evidence

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-transport-tcp`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-0A23323D](P0.md#rv-transport-tcp-0a23323d) (allocation P0, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** rustls 0.23.37 auto-installs the unambiguous AWS-LC default. Its crypto/mod.rs and client/client_conn.rs retain panic paths for ambiguous/custom-provider selection without installation or incompatible provider suites. No current-default boot failure is established.

<a id="l3-rv-transport-tcp-11f795d1"></a>

### L3-RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-11F795D1 — Client TLS12 rejection test cannot distinguish a version-selection regression

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-transport-tcp`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-11F795D1](P1.md#rv-transport-tcp-11f795d1) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The test asserts only client_result.is_err and ignores the server result. If make_client_config_no_ca is changed to offer TLS12 as well, NoCaVerify::verify_tls12_signature still returns Tls12NotOffered, so the test remains green after negotiation advances into TLS12. rustls 0.23.37 src/client/tls12.rs invokes that callback. Published source: https://docs.rs/crate/rustls/0.23.37/source/src/client/tls12.rs.

<a id="l3-rv-transport-tcp-17e11df1"></a>

### L3-RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-17E11DF1 — Project-specific exporter is incorrectly described as strict RFC 9266 compliance

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-transport-tcp`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-17E11DF1](P2.md#rv-transport-tcp-17e11df1) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The implementation and project specification use EXPORTER-ShamirDB-AUTH-v1. RFC 9266 §2 fixes a different label, EXPORTER-Channel-Binding. Internal same-helper roundtrips cannot detect this standards-description mismatch. The custom binding is not thereby shown insecure; document it as a deliberate project-specific exporter, preserving deployed bytes unless a separately versioned protocol change is intended. See [RFC 9266 §2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9266.html#section-2).

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/tls.rs:6](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/tls.rs); [crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/tls.rs:18](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/tls.rs); [crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/tls.rs:80](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/tls.rs); [docs/guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/TRANSPORT_TCP.md:41](../../../guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/TRANSPORT_TCP.md); [docs/guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/SECURITY_MODEL.md:154](../../../guide-docs/client-server-protocol-spec/SECURITY_MODEL.md).

### L3-RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-FF2983EC — Post-error stream state is undocumented (`TooLarge` desyncs the stream)

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-transport-tcp`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TRANSPORT-TCP-FF2983EC](P1.md#rv-transport-tcp-ff2983ec) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

Receive reuse applies only to fitting caller scratch; exact tungstenite 0.24.0 allocates frame/message storage and production allocates fresh request Vecs.

<a id="l3-rv-tunables-c09f4aa6"></a>

### L3-RV-TUNABLES-C09F4AA6 — Setters accept degenerate values unvalidated; millisecond quantization silently truncates to zero

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-tunables`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TUNABLES-C09F4AA6](P1.md#rv-tunables-c09f4aa6) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** 900 microseconds becomes zero; Duration::new(18446744073709551, 616000000) also becomes zero because its 2^64 milliseconds narrow modulo 2^64. <a id="l3-rv-tx-3b9f4d3b"></a>

### L3-RV-TX-3B9F4D3B — history_of: N sequential lookup_ts point-reads

**Дополнительный verdict:** `partially-fixed`. **Модули:** `shamir-tx`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TX-3B9F4D3B](P2.md#rv-tx-3b9f4d3b) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `partially-fixed`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Current history_of снимает retained overlay до scan, объединяет и dedup versions, предпочитает pending_ts. Для каждой timeline version, чей pending stamp отсутствует, loop всё ещё отдельно await lookup_ts; Nd таких drained/unstamped versions дают Nd последовательных point gets, не один get_many. Overlay-only retained versions со stamp больше не делают прежний durable lookup. Это cold/admin path batching opportunity без измеренного ущерба.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Внешняя sourceправка убрала “каждая entry всегда читает history ts” allegation для pending-stamped entries. Новые registered tests требуют точные 1/2/3 значения/stamps, merge uniqueness, tombstone и key isolation; не выполнялись. Timestamp absence/I/O ambiguity и durable retirement — отдельные механизмы.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs:224](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs); [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs:223](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mvcc_history.rs); [crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs:1625](../../../../crates/shamir-tx/src/mvcc_store/mod.rs).

<a id="l3-rv-types-6866d8b8"></a>

### L3-RV-TYPES-6866D8B8 — Ext32 skip arithmetic violates the lens's panic-free promise on 32-bit targets

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-types`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TYPES-6866D8B8](P0.md#rv-types-6866d8b8) (allocation P0, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The Ext32 skip arm reads n as usize and computes 1+n before passing it to checked_add. With n=u32::MAX on a 32-bit target, that intermediate addition panics with overflow checks or wraps without them. A tiny map containing this value before a searched-for field reaches the arm; no huge allocation is required. The matched-value decoder uses separate checked addition and does not have this particular bug. Current native 64-bit deployment is not the witness; a target-gated malformed Ext32 skip oracle is needed.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:401](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:404](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:598](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:849](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs); [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/mod.rs:38](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/mod.rs).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs:401](../../../../crates/shamir-types/src/record_view/lens.rs): <code>0xc9 =&gt; { / let n = read_be::&lt;4&gt;(buf, pos)? as usize; / *pos = pos</code>.

<a id="l3-rv-wal-48749f97"></a>

### L3-RV-WAL-48749F97 — Reopen resets the active commit maximum rather than restoring the documented cross-segment watermark

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wal`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WAL-48749F97](P1.md#rv-wal-48749f97) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Write version 60 into a lone active segment below the rotation threshold and reopen it: bytes_written is restored but max_committed initializes to zero, repair does not decode/seed it, and SegmentSet::max_committed therefore returns zero despite retaining version 60. This is separate from next_seq's per-handle ambiguity. Direct callers can subsequently append a lower maximum, seal and obtain unsafe truncation eligibility; ordinary engine version allocation instead scans recovered entries and assigns higher versions, providing substantial production counter-evidence. The existing reopen test rotates every entry and has an empty active segment, so it does not catch this obligation.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-wal/src/wal_segment.rs:178](../../../../crates/shamir-wal/src/wal_segment.rs); [crates/shamir-wal/src/wal_segment.rs:417](../../../../crates/shamir-wal/src/wal_segment.rs); [crates/shamir-wal/src/segment_set.rs:173](../../../../crates/shamir-wal/src/segment_set.rs); [crates/shamir-wal/src/segment_set.rs:583](../../../../crates/shamir-wal/src/segment_set.rs); [crates/shamir-wal/src/tests/segment_set_tests.rs:250](../../../../crates/shamir-wal/src/tests/segment_set_tests.rs); [crates/shamir-engine/src/repo/repo_instance.rs:750](../../../../crates/shamir-engine/src/repo/repo_instance.rs).

### L3-RV-WAL-59E3DBA1 — Leader tenure is unbounded under sustained arrival — the leader's own append future cannot resolve

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wal`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WAL-59E3DBA1](P2.md#rv-wal-59e3dba1) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The leader checks its completed waiter only after drain-until-empty returns. Sustained arrivals keeping each pending observation nonempty delay that caller indefinitely while followers make progress.

### L3-RV-WAL-9CB60C5A — A single CRC-valid-but-undecodable frame aborts the entire recovery (version skew == corruption)

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wal`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WAL-9CB60C5A](P1.md#rv-wal-9cb60c5a) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Fail-closed replay is appropriate and unknown versions have distinct text. A concrete documentation/compatibility defect exists for pre-5575ad59 version-1 bodies: positional insertion of commit_version was unversioned and current legacy decoding cannot recover an old empty-ops body. <a id="l3-rv-wal-c37b110a"></a>

### L3-RV-WAL-C37B110A — Per-segment seq counter restarts at 0 on reopen — returned last_seq can collide with pre-existing frames

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wal`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WAL-C37B110A](P2.md#rv-wal-c37b110a) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Reopening initializes next_seq to zero despite existing frames. The return is not a persisted identifier and production discards it; the remaining issue is insufficiently explicit per-handle scope.

<a id="l3-rv-wal-dd492f5c"></a>

### L3-RV-WAL-DD492F5C — Unauthenticated WAL replay is an injection surface; the data directory is trusted assumption is implicit and undocumented

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wal`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WAL-DD492F5C](P2.md#rv-wal-dd492f5c) (allocation P2, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

<a id="l3-rv-wasm-host-58c052b0"></a>

### L3-RV-WASM-HOST-58C052B0 — Compile child-process teardown is incomplete on every abnormal-exit path (no Job Object; kill-failure waits unbounded; error path never kills)

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wasm-host`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WASM-HOST-58C052B0](P1.md#rv-wasm-host-58c052b0) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Timeout ignores kill failure then waits and joins without bounds; wait failure joins without kill/reap; only cargo is targeted. A running descendant retaining a pipe can block reader joins even after cargo exits. No deterministic teardown oracle observes descendants or EOF.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** The launched cargo process has no group/job ownership and only child.kill is invoked. Only the cargo child is killed; descendants are not owned as a tree and can retain pipe handles.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs:607](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs:563](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs:598](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs:600](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/compile.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/tests/compile_tests.rs:263](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/tests/compile_tests.rs).

<a id="l3-rv-wasm-host-935f15d1"></a>

### L3-RV-WASM-HOST-935F15D1 — Both glob matchers reject valid repeated-suffix matches

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wasm-host`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WASM-HOST-935F15D1](P1.md#rv-wasm-host-935f15d1) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The documented star matches zero or more characters, but the algorithm chooses the first occurrence of the final literal and then requires that position to end the text. Pattern *_KEY with text X_KEY_KEY therefore returns false although the suffix matches; *.example.com similarly rejects a.example.com.example.com. Both environment seeding and egress policy use this algorithm. This is a present false-negative contract defect, separate from copied-code drift, and does not widen authorization. Existing fixtures lack repeated final literals; an explicit suffix witness must remain after deduplication.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/env_policy.rs:31](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/env_policy.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/env_policy.rs:90](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/env_policy.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/env_policy.rs:102](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/env_policy.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/net_gateway.rs:499](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/net_gateway.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/net_gateway.rs:510](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/net_gateway.rs); [crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/tests/env_policy_tests.rs:20](../../../../crates/shamir-wasm-host/src/tests/env_policy_tests.rs).

<a id="l3-rv-wasm-host-df4ad1da"></a>

### L3-RV-WASM-HOST-DF4AD1DA — Stringly-typed errors across the public gateway traits and egress guards

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wasm-host`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WASM-HOST-DF4AD1DA](P1.md#rv-wasm-host-df4ad1da) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Gateway methods and guards flatten failure classification and causes into String, contrary to the project's library-error convention. This is API/error-design debt; typed host errors alone would not make guest DB traps catchable.

<a id="l3-rv-wasm-host-eae6abe8"></a>

### L3-RV-WASM-HOST-EAE6ABE8 — `FunctionRegistry::rename` rollback can silently drop the function

**Дополнительный verdict:** `confirmed-open`. **Модули:** `shamir-wasm-host`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-WASM-HOST-EAE6ABE8](P1.md#rv-wasm-host-eae6abe8) (allocation P1, scoped risk `low`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** After source removal, separate registrations occupy target and source. Target insertion fails, source restoration also fails, and the original Arc is dropped. The caller receives only AlreadyExists(target). Holding two entry guards naively is not a safe remedy because bucket aliasing can deadlock.

**Дополнительный verdict:** `higher-risk-only`. **Модули:** `shamir-storage`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-STORAGE-822DBD98](P1.md#rv-storage-822dbd98) (allocation P1, scoped risk `medium`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** The accepted residual is transient absence during remove/reinsert, not older-overlapping-writer completion order. That concurrency behavior remains medium; no independent low facet is manufactured from the old title.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Собственный accepted verdict каждой строки сохранён в ledger; redirect означает исключение из дополнительной low/nit очереди, не fixed, refuted или safe.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs:129](../../../../crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs); [crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs:130](../../../../crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs); [crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs:124](../../../../crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs); [Cargo.lock:3123](../../../../Cargo.lock).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs:129](../../../../crates/shamir-storage/src/storage_in_memory.rs): <code>self.data.remove_sync(&amp;k); / let _ = self.data.insert_sync(k, v); / true</code>.

**Source rows / исходная risk-метка:** [shamir-storage/correctness-tdd.md · Claim 7](shamir-storage/correctness-tdd.md#review-7) (`low`, accepted `confirmed-open`).

### L3-RV-TRANSPORT-WS-624F81B1-REDIRECT — Send path has no frame-size cap and truncates the length prefix at `u32::MAX` — diverges from the TCP sibling

**Дополнительный verdict:** `higher-risk-only`. **Модули:** `shamir-transport-ws`. **Accepted canon:** [RV-TRANSPORT-WS-624F81B1](P1.md#rv-transport-ws-624f81b1) (allocation P1, scoped risk `medium`, verdict `confirmed-open`).

**Механизм / обязанность / граница:** Missing local ceiling and unchecked usize→u32 narrowing are the accepted medium send-boundary mechanism. A >=2^32 caller-owned payload is conditional and huge, but the mechanism is not pure nit/style and is not reassigned here.

**Counter-scope / оставшаяся premise:** Собственный accepted verdict каждой строки сохранён в ledger; redirect означает исключение из дополнительной low/nit очереди, не fixed, refuted или safe.

**Current source evidence:** [crates/shamir-transport-ws/src/framing.rs:118](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-ws/src/framing.rs); [crates/shamir-server/src/config.rs:418](../../../../crates/shamir-server/src/config.rs); [crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/framing.rs:153](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-tcp/src/framing.rs); [Cargo.lock:4467](../../../../Cargo.lock); [crates/shamir-transport-ws/src/framing.rs:157](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-ws/src/framing.rs).

**Прямой прочитанный фрагмент:** [crates/shamir-transport-ws/src/framing.rs:118](../../../../crates/shamir-transport-ws/src/framing.rs): <code>let len = payload.len() as u32; / let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(4 + payload.len()); / buf.extend_from_slice(&amp;len.to_be_bytes());</code>.

## Static-only evidence limits и сохранность

Проверяются только готовые Markdown: actual primary-key uniqueness/coverage, arithmetic, local target/anchors, cited file:line bounds, readback/fingerprints и сохранность inputs/current source/старых P0–P2. External URLs — direct provenance, не запуск dependency/runtime. Fixed не означает tests passed; unverified/high-risk-only не означает safe. Историческая mixed style delivery не исправлена этим review. Блоков реализации, placeholders и требований выполнить проект в этом продолжении нет.
